column3: With respect to the Gardenhouse Mortgage Loan (3.6%), the borrower defaulted on monthly debt service payments and reserve deposits on the prior securitized loan secured by the Mortgaged Property (the “Prior Gardenhouse Loan”) in January and February 2026, and thereafter defaulted in repayment of the Prior Gardenhouse Loan at its maturity in February 2026.
